key_insight: Human-in-the-loop prompting with SAM can substantially improve pulmonary nodule segmentation, even with junior or non-medical annotators.
clinical_relevance: This approach may reduce radiologist workload and enable scalable, safer annotation workflows for chest CT segmentation.
method: Built Hi-Seg on the Segment Anything Model (SAM) for pulmonary nodule segmentation.
Humans iteratively refined prompts using trial-and-error and semantic reasoning to guide mask quality.
Evaluated collaborative human-SAM segmentation across multiple annotator groups and external centers.
evidence_signal: Using chest CT scans from 1,179 patients across 12 centers, Hi-Seg achieved a mean Dice score of nearly 85% and outperformed five deep learning models and 13 SAM variants.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of human prompt refinement and may not generalize without task-specific training or workflow integration.
paper_title: Human and AI collaboration for pulmonary nodule segmentation
